fields.minimum_evidence: Actual employment or owner/director engagement category, employer-cost assumptions and exclusive EIC/CETP role-month/time allocation before charging costs.
fields.candidate_treatment: Explicit role-specific future estimates; no new assertion of existing payroll contracts; zero paid board PM.

fields.minimum_evidence: Normal useful lives, attributable use, ready-for-use dates, recoverable VAT and purchase/service/rental terms. Classify C12 as temporary service only if the final scope is a service.
fields.candidate_treatment: Estimated lives and use, full acquisition cash separate from depreciation; staggered contactor commissioning.

fields.area: CETP allocation and HPE incremental use
fields.minimum_evidence: Executed CETP work/cost allocation and relevant background/site rights mapped to EIC employee time, assets, test IDs, services and invoices.
fields.candidate_treatment: Distinct productisation outputs and incremental cost plan; no claim of a newly audited full grant ledger or new HPE contract.
fields.owner: Company project lead and CETP coordinator

fields.minimum_evidence: Comparable supplier scopes/prices, independent test-body applicability and actual facility/access windows before contracts.
fields.candidate_treatment: Dated reasonable engineering estimates and a non-overlapping unit/fixture calendar, not bookings or quotations.

fields.minimum_evidence: Actual Seed/EIC-investment conditions and grant payment/retention schedule when known, combined with intervening company cash flows.
fields.candidate_treatment: Targets kept separate from receipts; 60/25/15 timing scenario is illustrative; EUR300k November cash not assumed unchanged at future M1.
